message.content: On August 6, 2026, in a message shared by Turalyon, it is revealed that the garden project includes several new components. These include the installation of temporary barriers to limit noisy activities from 2-3 pm, a plan to notify residents a day in advance about particularly loud work, and the creation of a notice board at the entrance of the garden. Additionally, the proposal suggests using sound-absorbing materials for benches and play areas to mitigate noise. Furthermore, the garden will incorporate native plant species to support local wildlife, including the creation of a specific area for native plants that can serve as an educational point for residents. Lastly, the garden will feature a mix of colorful flowers and herbs, with seating areas designed to blend with the natural surroundings and accommodate various needs, making it a welcoming and functional space for the community.
